tagline.en: Shipments, events, evidence and export documents in one place — Carta Porte in 30 seconds instead of 8 minutes.
tagline.zh: 发运、事件、证据与出口单据集中在同一平台——Carta Porte 生成时间从 8 分钟缩短至 30 秒。

problem.en: Shipment information was spread across lists, spreadsheets, emails, photos and manual records. Following a shipment, finding its evidence or preparing its export documents meant searching in several places.
problem.zh: 发运信息分散在列表、电子表格、邮件、照片和手工记录中。跟踪一票货、查找证据或准备出口单据，都需要在多个地方来回查找。

solution.en: A digital platform that brings shipment records, events, photo evidence and export documentation together, with role-based modules, mobile apps and automated flows. Initial scope: daily operation for customer HC18.
solution.zh: 一个数字化平台，将发运记录、事件、照片证据与出口单据整合在一起，配有按角色划分的模块、移动应用和自动化流程。初始范围：客户 HC18 的日常运营。

en: Shipments and their events are registered and tracked in one data model.
Photo evidence is captured from a mobile app at the point of work.
Export documentation, including Carta Porte, is generated automatically.
Documents and evidence are kept in one central repository.
Role-based views give visibility for follow-up and incident handling.
zh: 发运及其事件在统一的数据模型中登记和跟踪。
在作业现场通过移动应用拍摄照片证据。
自动生成出口单据，包括 Carta Porte。
单据与证据集中存放在统一的资料库中。
按角色划分的视图支持跟进与异常处理。

systems.en: Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint, Office Scripts

screenshot — mobile evidence capture

截图 — 移动端证据采集

en: What results are documented? || Carta Porte generation went from 8 minutes to 30 seconds, average processing from 2 hours to under 1.5 hours, and chargeback delay risk from 26% to 7%. About 163 hours are saved per year.
Who is on the team? || Project lead: Pablo David Gonzalez Barron. Solution architecture, app development, interface design, flow automation, deployment and maintenance: Miguel Angel Contreras Ferrut.
zh: 有哪些已记录的成果？ || Carta Porte 生成时间从 8 分钟降至 30 秒，平均处理时间从 2 小时降至 1.5 小时以内，拒付延误风险从 26% 降至 7%。每年约节省 163 小时。
团队成员有哪些？ || 项目负责人：Pablo David Gonzalez Barron。方案架构、应用开发、界面设计、流程自动化、部署与维护：Miguel Angel Contreras Ferrut。

tagline.en: Complex customs declarations verified in 20 minutes instead of 90.
tagline.zh: 复杂报关单核对从 90 分钟缩短至 20 分钟。

problem.en: The export VoBo meant extracting and comparing information from the pedimento or proforma and the invoices by hand. Complex declarations, with more than 40 lines, took about 90 minutes each.
problem.zh: 出口 VoBo 需要人工从报关单（pedimento）或形式发票与商业发票中提取并比对信息。超过 40 行的复杂报关单，每份约需 90 分钟。

solution.en: Automates reading and comparing the pedimento or proforma against the invoices. The data is organised into a standard validation template that supports the review of declared quantities, invoice information and packing requirements. It started with one customer and now covers all export customers.
solution.zh: 自动读取并比对报关单或形式发票与商业发票。数据整理为标准校验模板，支持核对申报数量、发票信息与包装要求。最初仅服务一个客户，现已覆盖全部出口客户。

en: The export clerk loads the pedimento or proforma and the invoices.
Python executables extract and parse both documents.
Data is reorganised and compared automatically — no copy and paste.
A finished validation template is generated for the clerk to review.
The analysed pedimento layout is produced alongside it.
zh: 出口文员载入报关单或形式发票及商业发票。
Python 可执行程序提取并解析两类单据。
数据自动重组与比对——无需复制粘贴。
生成完整的校验模板，供文员审核。
同时生成已解析的报关单版式。

systems.en: Python executables, Excel (first version: Power Automate, AI Builder)
systems.zh: Python 可执行程序、Excel（首版：Power Automate、AI Builder）

en: screenshot — finished validation template
screenshot — analysed pedimento layout
zh: 截图 — 完成的校验模板
截图 — 已解析的报关单版式

en: What results are documented? || Complex declarations went from 90 to 20 minutes, across roughly 312 declarations a year — about 364 hours of capacity released.
Does it still use AI Builder? || No. The first version used Power Automate, AI Builder and Excel. The current version runs as Python executables that extract and parse the documents directly.
Who is on the team? || Business lead: Adriana Juarez. Design, development, testing and deployment: Miguel Angel Contreras Ferrut. Users: export clerks.
zh: 有哪些已记录的成果？ || 复杂报关单从 90 分钟降至 20 分钟，每年约 312 份，约释放 364 小时产能。
现在还使用 AI Builder 吗？ || 不再使用。首版基于 Power Automate、AI Builder 与 Excel；当前版本以 Python 可执行程序直接提取并解析单据。
团队成员有哪些？ || 业务负责人：Adriana Juarez。设计、开发、测试与部署：Miguel Angel Contreras Ferrut。使用者：出口文员。

tagline.en: Every carrier invoice validated in 1.5 minutes instead of 15, with the evidence filed automatically.
tagline.zh: 每张承运商发票的校验时间从 15 分钟缩短至 1.5 分钟，证据自动归档。

problem.en: Each transport service invoice was checked by hand: read the invoice, work out the applicable rate, compare the amount and chase the supporting documents — about 15 minutes per invoice, around 1,040 times a year.
problem.zh: 每张运输服务发票都需人工核对：阅读发票、确定适用费率、比对金额并追查支持文件——每张约 15 分钟，每年约 1,040 次。

solution.en: An automated validator that extracts the invoice data, applies the rate rules, detects exceptions and records the evidence. Successful validations are notified by email with the documents attached.
solution.zh: 自动校验工具：提取发票数据、应用费率规则、识别异常并记录证据。校验通过后自动发送邮件通知，并附上相关单据。

en: The carrier's invoice is received and processed.
AI Builder extracts the relevant data.
The applicable rate is determined from the number of containers.
The amount and the supporting documents are validated.
A folio, stamp and evidence record are generated, and the validation is notified.
zh: 接收并处理承运商发票。
AI Builder 提取相关数据。
根据集装箱数量确定适用费率。
校验金额与支持文件。
生成编号、印章与证据记录，并发送校验通知。

en: screenshot — validation email with attached evidence
screenshot — evidence record in SharePoint
zh: 截图 — 附证据的校验邮件
截图 — SharePoint 中的证据记录

en: What results are documented? || Validation time fell from 15 to 1.5 minutes (90% less), across about 1,040 validations a year — 234 hours saved annually. Testing logged 60 successful runs.
What happens if the extraction is wrong? || The flows are designed so that an incorrect detection does not continue automatically; it stops for review.
Who is on the team? || Lead: Miguel Angel Contreras Ferrut — architecture, automation and deployment.
zh: 有哪些已记录的成果？ || 校验时间从 15 分钟降至 1.5 分钟（减少 90%），每年约 1,040 次，年节省 234 小时。测试阶段成功运行 60 次。
如果识别出错怎么办？ || 流程设计为识别错误时不会自动继续，而是停下等待人工审核。
团队成员有哪些？ || 负责人：Miguel Angel Contreras Ferrut——架构、自动化与部署。

tagline.en: One Master Report instead of 23 tracking reports — with KuaiBot and Ocean Control Tower answering from the same source.
tagline.zh: 以一份主报表取代 23 份跟踪报表——KuaiBot 与 Ocean Control Tower 基于同一数据源作答。

problem.en: Ocean import depended on 23 separate tracking reports. Updating them over and over meant double capture, lost time, possible inconsistencies and limited visibility of upcoming events.
problem.zh: 海运进口依赖 23 份独立的跟踪报表。反复更新导致重复录入、耗费时间、可能出现数据不一致，且难以预见即将发生的事件。

solution.en: A Master Report with ocean shipment, container, status and progress data. It replaces the fragmented reports and feeds the operational outputs and two AI agents: KuaiBot, which gives container status to users outside Logistics with per-user access filters, and Ocean Control Tower, which analyses the same source for KPIs, risks and trends for authorised users.
solution.zh: 一份包含海运发运、集装箱、状态与进度数据的主报表。它取代分散的报表，并为各项运营输出和两个 AI 助手提供数据：KuaiBot 向物流以外的用户提供集装箱状态，并按用户设定访问权限；Ocean Control Tower 基于同一数据源为授权用户分析 KPI、风险与趋势。

en: Ocean shipment, container and status data are kept in one Master Report.
Critical-container reports and the daily ocean report are generated from it.
Upcoming warehouse arrivals and carrier arrivals are notified.
Cycle time is measured from arrival to operation close.
Data is extracted for cartas encomienda and the China report flow.
KuaiBot and Ocean Control Tower answer questions from the same source.
zh: 海运发运、集装箱与状态数据集中在一份主报表中。
据此生成关键集装箱报表与每日海运报表。
提前通知即将到达仓库的货物及承运商到场信息。
测量从到港到作业关闭的周期时间。
为委托书（cartas encomienda）与 China report 流程提取数据。
KuaiBot 与 Ocean Control Tower 基于同一数据源回答问题。

systems.en: Excel Online, SharePoint, Power Automate, AI agents (KuaiBot, Ocean Control Tower)
systems.zh: Excel Online、SharePoint、Power Automate、AI 助手（KuaiBot、Ocean Control Tower）

en: screenshot — Master Report
screenshot — KuaiBot answering a container status question
zh: 截图 — 主报表
截图 — KuaiBot 回答集装箱状态查询

en: What results are documented? || Tracking sources went from 23 to 1, and the daily update cycle from 4.5 to 1.5 hours.

What is the difference between KuaiBot and Ocean Control Tower? || KuaiBot shares container status with users outside Logistics and filters what each user can see. Ocean Control Tower reads the whole source without per-user filters and offers KPIs, observations, risks and trends, so it is shared only with authorised users.
Who is on the team? || Lead: Litzy Sanchez. Team: Pablo David Gonzalez Barron and Gualberto Carlos.
zh: 有哪些已记录的成果？ || 跟踪数据源从 23 个减至 1 个，每日更新周期从 4.5 小时缩短至 1.5 小时。
KuaiBot 与 Ocean Control Tower 有何区别？ || KuaiBot 向物流以外的用户共享集装箱状态，并按用户过滤可见内容。Ocean Control Tower 读取完整数据源、不做用户级过滤，提供 KPI、观察、风险与趋势分析，因此仅向授权用户开放。
团队成员有哪些？ || 负责人：Litzy Sanchez。团队：Pablo David Gonzalez Barron、Gualberto Carlos。

launched.zh: 自 2026 年 7 月起试点

tagline.en: Container status checked on the carrier's platform by a robot — 2 minutes a day instead of 20.
tagline.zh: 由机器人在承运商平台查询集装箱状态——每天 2 分钟，而非 20 分钟。

problem.en: Ocean import container status had to be looked up by hand on the carrier's platform every day and copied into the tracking files.
problem.zh: 海运进口集装箱状态每天都要在承运商平台人工查询，再复制到跟踪文件中。

solution.en: A robot that queries container status on the COSCO Shipping platform on a schedule and syncs the results to a central SharePoint repository, so the team can focus on following up exceptions.
solution.zh: 机器人定时在中远海运（COSCO Shipping）平台查询集装箱状态，并将结果同步至 SharePoint 中央资料库，让团队专注于跟进异常。

en: The robot runs on a recurring schedule.
It queries each container's status on the COSCO Shipping platform.
Results are synced to the central SharePoint repository.
The team follows up only the exceptions.
zh: 机器人按固定周期运行。
在中远海运平台逐一查询集装箱状态。
结果同步至 SharePoint 中央资料库。
团队只需跟进异常情况。

en: screenshot — container status repository
zh: 截图 — 集装箱状态资料库

en: Can it cover other carriers? || Yes. The approach extends to any logistics provider that requires recurring look-ups and manual capture.
Who built it? || Miguel Angel Contreras Ferrut — design and development.
zh: 能否扩展到其他承运商？ || 可以。该方法适用于任何需要定期查询和人工录入的物流服务商。
由谁开发？ || Miguel Angel Contreras Ferrut——设计与开发。

items.name: CCP Import Automation
items.nameZh: 进口 Carta Porte 自动化

tagline.en: Import Carta Porte prepared in 5–10 minutes instead of 45–60.
tagline.zh: 进口 Carta Porte 编制时间从 45–60 分钟缩短至 5–10 分钟。

problem.en: Preparing an import Carta Porte meant searching the validation file across several sheets and copying invoice numbers, parts, descriptions, quantities and CNY values by hand — 45 to 60 minutes each, with a real risk of errors.
problem.zh: 编制进口 Carta Porte 需要在校验文件的多个工作表中查找，并手工复制发票号、零件号、描述、数量与人民币金额——每份 45 至 60 分钟，且容易出错。

solution.en: A semi-automatic template: the import analyst enters the shipment's invoices and the template pulls the rest from the validation file automatically.
solution.zh: 半自动模板：进口分析员输入该票货的发票，其余信息由模板自动从校验文件中调取。

en: The import analyst enters the shipment's invoice numbers.
The template looks them up across the sheets of the validation file.
Parts, descriptions, quantities and CNY values are filled in automatically.
The analyst reviews and issues the Carta Porte.
zh: 进口分析员输入该票货的发票号。
模板在校验文件的各工作表中查找对应数据。
自动填入零件号、描述、数量与人民币金额。
分析员审核后开具 Carta Porte。

en: screenshot — Carta Porte template filled from the validation file
zh: 截图 — 由校验文件自动填写的 Carta Porte 模板

en: How many are prepared? || About 624 import Cartas Porte a year.
Who is on the team? || Lead: Juan Manuel Cardona Dominguez. Users: import analysts.
zh: 每年编制多少份？ || 每年约 624 份进口 Carta Porte。
团队成员有哪些？ || 负责人：Juan Manuel Cardona Dominguez。使用者：进口分析员。

launched.zh: 自 2026 年 7 月起试点

tagline.en: About 58,000 files checked for missing documents in 15–20 minutes.
tagline.zh: 15–20 分钟内检查约 58,000 份档案的缺失文件。

problem.en: Legal audits require every shipment file to hold its required documents. Across tens of thousands of files, checking this by hand was a long review.
problem.zh: 法律审计要求每份发运档案都具备规定文件。面对数万份档案，人工逐一核查耗时漫长。

solution.en: A Python robot that walks through the required files, builds an inventory and a summary in Excel, and flags what is missing.
solution.zh: Python 机器人遍历规定档案，在 Excel 中生成清单与汇总，并标出缺失文件。

en: The robot runs monthly over the files required for legal audit.
It builds an inventory of every file found.
It checks against the required documents and flags the gaps.
An Excel summary is produced for follow-up.
zh: 机器人每月对法律审计所需档案运行一次。
为找到的每份文件建立清单。
对照规定文件核查并标出缺失。
生成 Excel 汇总，便于后续跟进。

en: screenshot — Excel audit summary
zh: 截图 — Excel 审计汇总

en: How big was the test? || 55,846 files covering eight months.
Who is on the team? || Lead: Pablo David Gonzalez Barron.
zh: 测试规模有多大？ || 覆盖八个月的 55,846 份文件。
团队成员有哪些？ || 负责人：Pablo David Gonzalez Barron。

scope.en: Master Report replacing 23 separate ocean import tracking reports, feeding daily outputs and the KuaiBot and Ocean Control Tower agents.
scope.zh: 以主报表取代 23 份独立的海运进口跟踪报表，为每日输出及 KuaiBot、Ocean Control Tower 提供数据。

outcome.en: Deployed and in use since 29 June 2026; daily cycle from 4.5 to 1.5 hours.
outcome.zh: 自 2026 年 6 月 29 日起部署使用；每日周期从 4.5 小时缩短至 1.5 小时。
